exact_statement: For Kc>=0 and 0<s<=L, define f(Kc,t)=sinh(sqrt(Kc)t)/sqrt(Kc) for Kc>0 and f(0,t)=t, and eta(Kc,t)=f(Kc,t)/t-1 for t>0. Under the original supplied eta(Kc,L)<1 domain, prove 0<=eta(Kc,s)<=eta(Kc,L)<1.
semantics.definitions: ADMITTED_INPUTS.json is controlling. The target inequalities and derivative signs are not premises.

signature_and_units.metric_signature: (-,+,+,+) project convention; this scalar component uses only positive real lengths

branches: Kc=0 uses f=t exactly and never divides by sqrt(Kc)
Kc>0 uses the principal positive real sqrt(Kc)
t=0 is outside eta's target domain
